import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;

Future<void> main() async {
  final program = Effect.build<String, String>(($) async {
    final value = await $(Effect.succeed<int, String>(42));
    final nullable = $.sync<String?>(const Success(null));
    return '$value:$nullable';
  });

  final exit = await Runtime().run(program);
  if (exit case Succeeded<String, String>(value: final value)) {
    if (value != '42:null') throw StateError('Unexpected value: $value');
  } else {
    throw StateError('Unexpected exit: $exit');
  }

  final Effect<int, _BaseError> widened = Effect.fail<int, _SpecificError>(
    const _SpecificError(),
  );
  final Effect<Result<int, _BaseError>, _BaseError> captured = widened.result();
  final recovered = widened.catchError(
    (_, _) => Effect.succeed<int, _BaseError>(1),
  );
  final capturedExit = await Runtime().run(captured);
  final widenedExit = await Runtime().run(recovered);
  if (capturedExit is! Succeeded<Result<int, _BaseError>, _BaseError>) {
    throw StateError('Expected a captured result.');
  }
  if (widenedExit is! Succeeded<int, _BaseError>) {
    throw StateError('Expected widened recovery to succeed.');
  }

  final Schedule<_BaseError, int, Never> retries = Schedule.recurs(1);
  final Effect<int, _BaseError> retried = widened.retry(retries);
  final Schedule<int, int, _BaseError> mappedPolicy = Schedule<int, int, _SpecificError>(
    () => (_) => Effect.fail(const _SpecificError()),
  ).mapError<_BaseError>((error, _) => error);
  await Runtime().run(retried);
  await Runtime().run(mappedPolicy.createStep()(0));

  final Flow<String, _BaseError> flow = Flow.fromIterable([1, 2])
      .widenError<_BaseError>()
      .map((value, context) => '$value:$context');
  final folded = flow.runFold<int>(
    0,
    (length, value, context) => length + value.length + context.hashCode,
  );
  await Runtime().run(folded);
  final concurrent = Flow.fromIterable([1, 2])
      .widenError<_BaseError>()
      .mergeMap(
        (value, context) => Flow.succeed('$value:$context'),
        concurrency: 2,
      );
  final combined = concurrent.withLatestFrom(
    Flow.succeed<String, _BaseError>('latest'),
    (primary, latest, context) => '$primary:$latest:$context',
  );
  await Runtime().run(combined.runDrain());
  final timed = flow
      .share(
        overflow: FlowOverflowPolicy.fail,
        onOverflow: (overflow, context) => _SpecificError(),
      )
      .bufferTime(
        Duration.zero,
        maxSize: 2,
        overflow: FlowOverflowPolicy.fail,
        onOverflow: (overflow, context) => _SpecificError(),
      )
      .debounce(
        Duration.zero,
        overflow: FlowOverflowPolicy.fail,
        onOverflow: (overflow, context) => _SpecificError(),
      )
      .throttle(
        Duration.zero,
        overflow: FlowOverflowPolicy.fail,
        onOverflow: (overflow, context) => _SpecificError(),
      );
  await Runtime().run(timed.runDrain());

  final cron = (Cron.fromFields(
    location: tz.UTC,
    seconds: const {0},
  ) as Success<Cron, CronError>).value;
  final Schedule<int?, Duration, _BaseError> calendar = Schedule.cron<int?>(cron)
      .mapError<_BaseError>((error, _) => _CalendarError(error));
  final Effect<int?, _BaseError> nullable = Effect.succeed(null);
  await nullable.repeat(Schedule.max(calendar, Schedule.recurs<int?>(0))).runFuture();

  final cacheProgram = Effect.build<void, _BaseError>(($) async {
    final cache = await $(
      Cache.make<String, int>(
        capacity: 2,
        timeToLive: const Duration(minutes: 5),
      ),
    );
    await $(cache.set('key', 3));
    await $(
      cache.invalidateWhere(
        (key, value, context) => key.length + value + context.hashCode < 0,
      ),
    );
  });
  await cacheProgram.runFuture();
}

sealed class _BaseError {
  const _BaseError();
}

final class _SpecificError extends _BaseError {
  const _SpecificError();
}

final class _CalendarError extends _BaseError {
  const _CalendarError(this.error);

  final CronError error;
}
